# Integer-addition command

Build a dependency-free Node command-line application that accepts two integer
arguments and prints their sum followed by exactly one newline. Missing or
non-integer arguments must write a useful nonempty error to stderr and exit
nonzero. Successful requests exit zero. Include component and user-acceptance
tests that execute the actual command, covering successful and invalid input.
Provide enough design and execution guidance for a user to run and verify it.
